messages:
sam: FYI product asked for a "sparse-telemetry" mode: drop most non-error payloads for very high QPS routes to cut costs. they want a Console switch per-tenant-route.

nina: Quick clarification: sparse-telemetry = payload sampling, or payload-stripping (metadata-only)? those are different guarantees.

sam: Product wants three modes: (1) metadata-only, (2) sampled payloads (low base rate w/ error/slow overrides), (3) full-fidelity. Console should show which is active.

omar: Billing note: dropping payloads does NOT imply billing reduction by default. we must be explicit: telemetry reduction != quota reduction unless tenant opts into billing_compaction. ops will need an enterprise opt-in.

lisa: We'll add a UI hint: "sparse mode does not affect billing unless billing_compaction is enabled (enterprise feature)."

devops-bot: AUTO: enabling metadata-only will still emit request_count metrics and quotas enforced on total token/request counters. See /policies/usage.

vanya: PII constraints: metadata-only still needs a redaction pre-check to avoid leaking snippets in headers/errors. post-redaction sampling is safer but redaction is CPU-heavy and may negate cost savings.

lee: Proposal: run a lightweight PII heuristic pre-check. If high-risk, route through full redaction and persist regardless of mode. Else do synthetic-redact (truncate+hash) then sample.

ownar: (correction: omar) Router auto-fallback is critical: if a sparse route sees error-rate spike, router should automatically switch to full-fidelity logging for a window and emit an audit event.

sam: Proposed auto-fallback policy: if error-rate > 3x baseline OR p50 latency > 2x for 5min => flip to full-fidelity for 10min and create audit event.

nina: Surface fallback in Console timeline + email alert option + manual override.

lisa: Legal: any retained payload (even sampled) must have TTL and be auditable. default TTL 14 days for sparse-mode retained payloads; max 30 days with tenant opt-in. Document in toggle details.

vanya: Fingerprinting: emit tenant-scoped HMAC fingerprint for dropped payloads so we can detect duplicates/regressions without storing plaintext. KMS-backed keys and rotation required. Store only truncated hash.

lee: SDKs: mobile clients sometimes batch requests offline. If server drops payloads, add a client-sent short fingerprint header to aid correlation. We'll document header and compute method.

sam: Example sparse config sketch:
```
route: /v1/chat/stream
sparse_mode: sampled_payloads
sample_config:
  base_sample_rate: 0.005
  error_override: 1.0
  slow_ms_override: 1000
precheck_heuristic: pii_risk_threshold=0.7
retain_ttl_days: 14
billing_compaction: false
```

omar: Console metrics to show: current_sample_rate, effective_storage_bytes_saved, incidents_triggering_auto_fallback, recent_auto_fallback_windows, cost-savings projection (30d).

nina: UX: add a confidence band on savings (low/med/high) and an exportable CSV: sampled_count, dropped_count, fingerprint_counts.

lisa: Ops: toggling sparse mode must emit audit event `sparse_mode.toggle` with who/when/route/mode/prev_mode and snapshot sampler config to support rollbacks.

vanya: Implementation notes: HMAC-SHA256 with tenant KMS key; store first 16 hex chars. Never persist plaintext. Mask error stacks referencing user tokens.

lee: Rollout plan: alpha (internal) -> beta (select customers) -> GA. Gate each stage with runbook checks (auto-fallback validation, retention compliance, smoke tests).

sam: Action items: @omar prototype router auto-fallback + metrics exporter (PR Mon), @vanya spec HMAC fingerprint + key rotation (Thu), @lisa coordinate legal retention signoff + Console copy (Fri), @nina design Console panel + CSV export (Tue), @lee update SDK header docs (Wed). I'll coordinate canary tenants.

devops-bot: REMINDER: add smoke job `sparse-mode-smoke` to nightly CI after alpha.

sam: I'll post a short explainer for product tooltip. thanks all.
